title: Motion for an extension of time to file the briefs on the merits

pages.text:
July 22, 2025
Honorable Scott S. Harris
Clerk of the Court
Supreme Court of the United States
One First Street, NE
Washington, DC 20543-0001
 Re: Hecox v. Little, No. 24-38 and
  B.P.J. v. West Virginia, No. 24-43

Dear Mr. Harris:
Pursuant to Rule 30.4, the parties in both above-captioned cases respectfully
request an extension of the briefing schedule. The petitions for a writ of certiorari
were both granted on July 3, 2025. Petitioners’ opening briefs on the merits, and
joint appendix, are currently due August 18, 2025. Respondents’ briefs on the
merits are due September 17, 2025.
The parties request that the due dates for each of their briefs be extended as
follows:
Opening Briefs: September 12, 2025
Joint Appendix: September 12, 2025
Response Briefs: November 10, 2025
Reply Briefs:  December 10, 2025
This extension of time is requested to accommodate professional and personal
obligations.
Respectfully Submitted,
s/John J. Bursch
John J. Bursch
Counsel for Petitioners

PROOF OF SERVICE

I, John J. Bursch, counsel for Petitioners and a member of the Bar of this Court,
certify that on this 22nd day of July, 2025, I caused the Motion for Extension of Time
for Merits Briefing to be served by electronic means on the following:

  Kathleen Hartnett
  Cooley LLP
  3 Embarcadero Center, 20th Floor
  San Francisco, CA 94111
  khartnett@cooley.com

Joshua Block
American Civil Liberties Union
125 Broad St.
New York, NY 10004
jblock@aclu.org

 I further certify that all parties required to be served have been served.


 Executed on July 22, 2025

       s/John J. Bursch
 JOHN J. BURSCH
